message.content:
1. **Inconsistent Unread Indicators**: The "Verification approved" and "New connection" notifications use a black dot to signify unread status, while the top two items ("New business enquiry" and "Welcome to BlakNet") lack this indicator despite appearing to be unread (or the logic for which items are marked is visually inconsistent).

2. **Misaligned Action Icons**: The checkmark icons on the right side of the notification list are not vertically centered with the text content; they appear positioned too high relative to the notification body, creating a visual imbalance in the row layout.
